name: Android Hardware Back Button & Matchmaking Cancel
greenMarker: Android Back Button and Radar Cancel behavior verified
note: Back has to land where the on-screen Cancel button lands. Anything else drops the player out of the app mid-search, which reads as a crash.

mutations.name: the back button stops closing the matchmaking radar
mutations.why: Back then falls through to the system and closes the app while the player is queued. They come back to find the search gone and no explanation.

mutations.name: the first Back on Home closes the app (the original bug)
mutations.why: One press of back on the home screen quits the game with no warning; "press again to exit" is never shown.

mutations.name: Back leaves the battle result without clearing it (the original bug)
mutations.why: After one back from a battle result, every later back lands in the lobby again: the player cannot leave it with back, nor close a dialog over it.
mutations.expectFailure: not stuck on the battle screen
